findings.title: Job failed
findings.cause: Job export was stopped by its own activeDeadlineSeconds (30): it was still running 30s after it started, so the Job controller ended its pods and failed the Job (0 of 1 completions had succeeded). Nothing crashed: the work was cut off, and its pods are gone

evidence.detail: Job was active longer than specified deadline

evidence.command: kubectl get job export -n kd-job-active-deadline -o jsonpath='{.spec.activeDeadlineSeconds}{" "}{.status.startTime}{" "}{.status.succeeded}'

findings.fix: If the work needs longer than 30s, recreate the Job with a higher activeDeadlineSeconds, or none: the deadline covers the whole Job from its start, every retry included. If the work hangs, read its log while it runs (kubectl logs -f job/export): once the deadline passes the pods are deleted.
